versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "培训现场执行全流程跟踪" tool for end-to-end management of training events.
- Supports tracking course execution, attendance, material distribution, assessments, and on-site issue logging.
- Generates daily execution logs and comprehensive training summary reports.
- Input required: training plan, participant roster, and materials list.
- Provides workflow guidance from event initialization to post-training summary and experience capture.
